set.pl: SW quarter of sec. 29 T5N R21E, Town (now City) of Franklin, Milwaukee Co.; John Ford's 160 acres on the 1876 Milwaukee County atlas, house dot near 42.859,-88.048
set.t: The whole quarter is the search field: the gold was buried by an old stump, suspicion fell on an adjoining field, and about $1,380 may remain, scattered by the plow. Today the quarter is mostly city and county park land (parcel data, 2026) with one farm parcel, not built over: check the park rules or get a permit before detecting, and ask permission on private land.
acc: Mostly city and Milwaukee County park land today: check the rules or get a permit first.
